title: Sharp Upper Bound on Hankel Determinant H3,2 for the Class SL*
content: In the article, a subclass of Starlike functions linked with Bernoulli,s lemniscate is studied in the unit disc. The bounds of H3,2 Hankel determinant, the sixth coefficient |b6| and the Zalcman functionals for the class SL* are obtained. The results are sharp.
